summary: End-to-end Micro-TIF workflow from city election and redeveloper standard form through 30-day city/CRA decision, project completion within two years, assessor completion/value determination, certification, and use of the tax increment to repay indebtedness.
plain_language: Micro-TIF is fast at the approval stage, but the money side is usually a reimbursement-style, post-completion increment process.

steps.action: elect by resolution to allow expedited reviews
prepare standard DED form with eligibility, value, increment, Question 6, and agreed costs
submit plan directly to governing body with local application fee not exceeding 50 dollars
approve or deny within 30 days after submission
if financed through division of taxes, incur project indebtedness within statutory limit
complete agreed work within two years and notify county assessor
determine completion and assessed value; certify completion, valuation increase, amount, and cause
after assessor certification, begin using sec. 18-2147 tax portion to pay indebtedness

relationships.note: Assessor base/excess and tax division administration.

source_refs.citation: Nebraska DED, Application for Expedited Review instructions, reissued June 2023.
